bugs.title: Chat panel crashes the whole app (destroy is not a function)
bugs.evidence: Clicking chip 'What needs me?' -> Emergent runtime error overlay 'destroy is not a function'; React warns useEffect returned non-function. Root cause: components/panels/ChatPanel.jsx:63 `useEffect(() => end.current?.scrollIntoView({...}), ...)` implicitly returns scrollIntoView's return value (a Promise in current Chromium). Fix: wrap body in braces. Reproduced 2/2. App is frontend-only (localStorage); preview URL 200, API 200. Screenshot: ai-command-bar-voice-failure.png

bugs.title: Call panel crashes the whole app (same useEffect pattern)
bugs.evidence: Approve -> open-call-button -> crash 'destroy is not a function', transcript-line-1 never renders. Root cause: components/panels/CallPanel.jsx:27 `useEffect(() => bottom.current?.scrollIntoView({...}), [lines.length])`. Reproduced 2/2. Screenshot: call-booking-driver-ack-failure.png

action_items.detail: At 1440 the Truck 103 label sits over the 'San Francisco' city label (reads 'S...isco'); truck labels don't overlap each other.
No backend lane: app state is localStorage only (no API-bearing criteria). Booking itself completes in background without opening the call panel (idempotency check passed), so only UI panels crash.
